title: Safehouse and Debt
author: Ines Pemberton
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
